note: Edges are correlations of detrended, deseasonalised monthly anomalies; they do not show cause and effect.
significance_note: p values use an effective sample size corrected for the lag-1 autocorrelation of both series; this is an approximation. Within a table the locations are neighbours, so the pooled test uses the median effective sample size of the locations, not their sum. q values are Benjamini-Hochberg over all tests of the same table.

methods.anomaly: monthly anomaly (calendar-month mean removed) minus the series' own least-squares line; no gap filling, each pair uses the months both series have
methods.lag: lag 0 pairs the same month; lag 1 pairs the source one month earlier with the target (source leads), tested in both directions
methods.pooled: r is computed over all locations of the table after standardising each location; the test uses the median effective sample size of the locations
methods.graph: edges are the tests with q < alpha; components and degree use those edges only (degree counts distinct neighbours)
methods.world: each city is tested on its own; one Benjamini-Hochberg correction over all cities, pairs and lags; the table counts the cities where a pair is significant and whether the sign agrees

modis_lst_pc.name_en: Daytime land surface temperature (MODIS Terra, via Planetary Computer)

modis_ndvi_pc.name_en: Vegetation greenness, NDVI (MODIS Terra 250 m 16-day, via Planetary Computer)
